etsy.title: Indoor Cat Enrichment Planner, Cat Care Tracker, 20 Cat Play Ideas, Kids Pet Chores, Cat Weight and Vet Log, Printable PDF
etsy.description:
Indoor cats are safe – but they still have a hunter's brain. This printable planner makes daily play, puzzles and calm easy, with little jobs for little helpers.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)
• Why indoor cats need a plan – signs of boredom + safe-home checklist
• Cat Profile – favorite toys, treats, nap spots and funny quirks
• Play & Care Tracker – 2 weeks of daily play, puzzles, water, litter and brushing
• 20 Enrichment Ideas – most cost nothing but a cardboard box
• Little Cat Helper – picture jobs and gentle cat rules for kids 3+
• Weight & Vet Log
• Our Cat's Happy Week planner

PERFECT FOR
• Busy families with an indoor cat
• Kids learning to care for a pet gently
• A sweet gift for a new cat parent

This planner is for everyday care and fun, not veterinary advice.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included. Print at home or at a print shop, as many times as you need for your family.

PLEASE NOTE
For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files. Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
